en: And I think because of social media maybe as well,
zh: 我觉得也可能也是因为社交媒体，

en: that I let so much of the noise make me even sadder,
zh: 让我把太多杂音放进心里，变得更加难过，

en: or make me feel like I was less worthy, less of a person,
zh: 让我觉得自己不够好，不够像一个完整的人，

en: that I needed to be so crumbled and embarrassed about what happened to me.
zh: 觉得自己必须崩溃，并为自己经历的一切感到羞耻。

en: Or yes, I probably would have had those feelings, but maybe not as long as I did.
zh: 也许本来我也会有这些感受，但可能不会持续那么久。

en: Because that narration was going on for so long,
zh: 因为那种负面叙述持续了太久，

en: and so I finally was sort of like, screw every dark noise I'm hearing.
zh: 最后我终于有种觉醒的感觉，去他的那些黑暗的声音。

en: And I'm going to say every day, no, I am worthy.
zh: 我每天都要告诉自己：不，我值得。

en: I'm worthy of a happy, beautiful, positive day.
zh: 我配得上一个快乐、美好、积极的一天。
以这种方式有意识地生活。

en: And it's funny when I wake my kids up every day,
zh: 有趣的是，每天我叫醒孩子们时，

en: I'm like, we're going to have a happy day because we choose to have a happy day.
zh: 我都会说：我们今天要开心，因为这是我们选择的。

en: But embedding in them those small little affirmations, I mean, I'm 40 and I need it.
zh: 把这些小小的积极暗示植入他们心里，说实话，我40岁了，我自己也需要。
